; VoiceKit bridge map — phrase <-> hotkey registry.
; Managed by "New Automation" and Voice Kit (the Hotkey button).
; Do not edit unless freeing a key.
;
; This file is also your RECREATE LIST: Voice Access shortcuts
; are stored per-machine with no backup, export, or sync. After
; a reinstall or on a new PC, recreate each voice shortcut below
; (say "show voice shortcuts" -> Create new shortcut).
; EXCEPTION: lines whose FILE ends in .hotkey.ahk are companion
; hotkeys (a keyboard trigger for a voice automation, assigned in
; Voice Kit) — they need NO Voice Access shortcut.
;
; Format: KEYCOMBO|PHRASE|FILE|CREATED
